submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ONLY edit target: 04 Mountain Guardian Boy current SOUTHEAST run frame 3. Image2 is a different character used ONLY for relative foot perspective comparison, NOT a passed gold standard; do not copy her pose or anatomy. Image3 locks boy identity/brown-gold boots. Image4 locks boy outfit/camera. Image5 locks approved clean rounded handpainted Daoist style. Edit ONLY the boots and immediate ankle transitions. Keep exact image1 head, expression, hair, shoulders, both arms/hand grips, solid-backed staff, shield, cloth, pelvis, knees, leg spacing, action phase, character scale and canvas registration. Do not move the knees or bring legs together. FIX: Large forward SCREEN LEFT boot currently points toward screen lower-left/camera. Rotate it at ankle toward lower-right, so its toe shifts a modest distance right of heel while ankle location stays fixed. Keep late planted-support, forefoot still close to virtual ground phase. The smaller rear screen-right boot also turns toward the same travel axis without changing its position or raised phase. The sole pitch must retain current contact/lift/toeoff phase, but foot YAW follows SE travel toward screen lower-right. Heel-to-toe axes of both feet must be coherent parallel in the ground plane; no duck feet pointing apart, no heel-toe axis toward lower-left or directly facing camera. Toe points lower-right beyond heel with natural ankle/shin alignment. Brown boot, gold toe/sole trim and green ankle beads unchanged. Preserve generous full-canvas margins and real transparent RGBA; one native square>=1024 image, no shadow/text/effects/grid. Configuration target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/max via host-managed builtin, actual version remains unconfirmed.
